title: At 80x24 the /model panel overflows the screen (key hints and later models cut off), and the status line drops different items per width
observed: kiln defect (layout). RESIZE 80 24 then /model: the panel lists models 1-17 and runs off the bottom; the 'Enter to set as default · s … · Esc' hint row, the effort row and models 18+ are not visible, and the input and status line are pushed off. Status line: at 80 cols it shows '…ort · main*  anthropic/claude-opus-4-8 ctx … 6%' (cost dropped, cwd cut to the meaningless '…ort'); at 60 cols it drops the model but shows the cost.
expected: The panel windows its list to the rows available and always shows its hint row. The status line drops items in one fixed priority order and keeps a recognisable cwd tail (e.g. 'linkshort').
